$description: HEREweHOLO HoloCast design tokens — single source of truth for Figma variables, Tailwind config and mockups. Dark-first: the product ships in one deliberate dark theme (mature AV/broadcast software).

cyan.description: Primary accent — actions, focus, live telemetry

beam.description: The beam — reserved for the primary action and brand moments only

error.description: Offline / error / stop (magenta, per brand — not pure red)

display.usage: Wordmark, screen titles, GO LIVE, large numerals. Uppercase + tracking for labels.

ui.usage: All running UI text, buttons, body copy.

mono.usage: Status strip, telemetry, resolutions, codes. Always tabular.

motion.principle: No decorative animation. Every transition explains a state change.
motion.reducedMotion: All loops (live pulse, connecting rings, ambient glow) freeze to their strongest static frame under prefers-reduced-motion.

statusStrip.format: HH:MM:SS · STATE · W × H · FF fps · BB.B Mbps
statusStrip.rule: Six live values, one line, monospace, never faked. 0 × 0 and OFFLINE are legitimate values; a resolution is only shown when the full chain has verified it.
